carnival illusionist, near-future, rendered as graphite concept art concept art moodboard, a desaturated Nordic palette, moss and lichen

STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. Lighting reference: a book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
